parsed.explanation: The worst feature is tier-2 state-targeting: police are documented (including by police and the NHRC themselves) as the foremost perpetrators of abuse against LGBTI people — systematic harassment, arbitrary detention, extortion using Section 365 as leverage, ignoring victims' complaints, and forced examinations amounting to torture. An international body lists vagrancy/personation provisions criminalising trans gender expression, a direct traveller exposure, alongside no anti-discrimination protection. Detention means birth-sex ward placement as default (tier-1 if reached). Prosecutions appear limited, which keeps this below the 0.15-0.20 conviction tiers. Offsetting: no trans-specific violence data, head-of-state and poll tolerance signals, community organisations, functional LGR (climate only). Police as perpetrators means rule-of-law functioning is liability, not recourse. Net: high risk from documented, state-acknowledged police predation.
